summary: SCTP carries multiple streams in one connection but large messages can block others. This document adds a new chunk type that lets a sender interleave pieces of different user messages, and defines stream schedulers that decide which stream sends next.

eli5.summary: If one person hogs the line at the checkout, everyone waits. This lets the cashier serve a bit of each person's order in turn.

questions: how to interleave messages in sctp
